notes: Hypothesis (my own hidden cards) refuted as the cause: of the 10 false proofs, 8 (3012080 x7 life 0, 3012137 life 0) come from the defensive deals themselves: defence value counts counter events (+3000/+4000) regardless of whether the opponent can pay them, so with 0-1 active DON both 'strong' hands are 3-4 unpayable events and weaker than the real hand; 3012218 is the same plus a life trigger; 3012157 is the life-trigger slot (§7.28). The own-hidden split (my dialog answer differs per deal right after a look/search) exists in 26/1049 proofs (2.5%, within forecast) but never decides the true-deal outcome. 55% of proofs do split across deals, mostly by the number of DON attached (adapting to the opponent's hidden hand per deal) - the §7.21 §8 caveat, out of scope here. Fix 'cost' (count counter events only within the opponent's active DON) removes 9/10 targets (7/7 on the da3438f wheel, 2/3 on the current wheel; 3012157 remains = life trigger) but loses 203 proofs that win on the true deal (121 refuted by the now-genuinely-strong hand, 84 to unknown; 190 of them won that turn in the record) = 10x the 20-point budget, so per §7.30-5 it is NOT adopted; the report §6 puts the decision to the user (these 203 are proofs the §7.21 design would never have granted; adopting means -19% proofs, +0% latency, needs a production arena). Fix 'hidden' removes 3012080 x7 for the wrong reason (every line goes through Izo's look-at-5), none of the current-wheel 3 points, loses 35, and gains 58 (budget freed) - not adopted. Invariant note: 'cost' gains 1 proof (3012249:p2:12:120, unknown->win by freed budget, all 8 deals win = sound). Current main wheel desyncs 25 of the 300 recorded games (12,710 points vs 13,473 in §7.28); seed 3012080 desyncs at step 101 (an extra Buggy dialog after rs-trigger-simul), so its 7 points were read on the da3438f wheel with the same trace patch (lethal.rs differs from main only cosmetically there). The 'trace' read-back of all proofs had a measurement quirk (continuing to the remaining deals after one fails consumed node budget: 15 wins -> unknown); fixed in df5d251, generalization counted on the 1,049 reproduced wins. Also fixed line_len for proofs that start with ATTACH_DON (was 1; stats field only).
